description: Very nice apartment, located in the heart of Paris, in the immediate vicinity of the "Réaumur-Sébastopol" metro station in the 3rd arrondissement. The apartment is on the 3rd floor of this beautiful luxury Haussmann building. Access is via a small elevator or stairs. The building is secure.The spaceThis beautiful 110 m2 apartment, completely refurbished and located on the 3rd floor with elevator of a Haussmann building, combines all the qualities required for an unforgettable stay with friends or family thanks to its style, comfort and location close to all amenities (bars, restaurants, metro...), and cultural centers (museums, galleries...)Guest accessLarge living room bathed in light with a sofa and armchairs. The kitchen is open to the living room and fully equipped (oven, microwave, induction cooktop, 2 refrigerators, dishwasher, etc.). The extendable dining table can accommodate up to 8-9 people. 2 shower rooms, one with direct access via master bedroom No. 1.The apartment has 4 bedrooms:Master Bedroom No. 1: queen size bed (160)Bedroom 2: queen size bed (160) + extra bed (90) or 2 single beds + extra bed (Arrangement to be agreed upon before your arrival)Bedroom 3: queen size bed (160)Bedroom 4: queen size bed (160) + shower roomOther things to noteThe rooms are all a good size for a Parisian apartment. At least 15 m² each.
